title: Ask for folder name if not provided in the arguments
body:
## Bug description

When the folder name is not provided, the CLI fails. This is an OK behavior when installed globally. However this is a problem with `yarn create` as yarn will check if there is a new version, which takes some time.

## How to reproduce

 - `yarn create instantsearch-app`
 - yarn downloads stuff
 - fail because there is no folder provided
 - type again `yarn create instantsearch-app folder`
 - download again
 - now it's good

## Expected behavior

A better user experience would be to ask for the missing parameter.
